# has couple event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCoupleEvent`](gmeow-hasCoupleEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCoupleEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/genealogy`](../../slices/genealogy.md)

Relates a couple relationship to an event in its history — the marriage, the divorce, an anniversary. The seam the GEDCOM projection walks: a marriage [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)'s [`gmeow:eventTime`](gmeow-eventTime.md) / [`gmeow:eventLocation`](gmeow-eventLocation.md) source [gedcom:date](http://www.w3.org/2000/10/swap/pim/gedcom#date) / [gedcom:place](http://www.w3.org/2000/10/swap/pim/gedcom#place) on the couple's Marriage node. Non-functional: a couple bears several events.
